2.3.6 Report.Classes
The Report.Classes element specifies classes to instantiate during report initialization. This element
is optional. This element is of type Classes.
Following is the parent element of the Report.Classes element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.Classes element.
 <xsd:element name="Classes" type="ClassesType" minOccurs="0" />
